_comment: Plan 0027, the pre-registered thresholds of benchmark R2, frozen before the first counted run and published before it (decision 7). Medians over 3 runs per cell; a direction, not statistics. Task keys, bug files and the human's words stay private until the results.
agent: Claude Code, headless, stream-json; model claude-sonnet-5-5

arms.W0: a written ticket, no human; the agent reproduces it itself
arms.W1: a human at a plain Simulator: the same words and a screenshot, the app left in the bug state
arms.W2: a human with the Parallax window: the same words sent from the window with a picked element or an attached network request, approvals on the window's cards

H1.statement: On the window tasks W2 beats W1 on at least one of: tasks fixed, wrong-file first edits, confident wrong answers, median agent cost; and W2 costs the human no more actions than W1.

all: fixed(W2) == fixed(W1) over the window tasks

H1.alsoFailedIf: humanActions(W2) > humanActions(W1), or attended minutes in the hand runs higher for W2

H2.statement: On the controls W0, W1 and W2 are equal within the spread of their three runs.
H2.falsifiedIf: a control's median cost or time in W2 is above the highest of the three W1 runs, or W2 fixes fewer controls than W1

reported: every task on its own as well as pooled; T3 separates W0 from W1 and W2, never W2 from W1
